basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Field Worker Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi (IIT (BHU)) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the Field Worker Staff post, which is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for one year and can be continued for next year depending on performance. Eligible candidates holding an M.Tech., B.Tech., MCA, M.Sc., or any graduate degree can apply. The pay is Rs. 24,000 per month plus HRA. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a minimum essential qualification of an M.Tech., B.Tech., MCA, M.Sc., or any graduate degree. The maximum age limit is 50 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India norms. Desirable Experience: Basic knowledge of drone flying, PCB design, or 3D printing.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (BHU) Field Worker Staff
content_sections.text: Download and fill out the application form strictly according to the attached format provided in the official notification. Gather self-attested copies of all required certificates and documents. Upload the completed application and documents via the Google form link: Google Form . Email the application to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Hari Prabhat Gupta, at [email protected] and CC to [email protected] . content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Principal Investigator has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit based on qualifications and experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by email to appear for the interview. Candidates must present original certificates and self-attested copies of all certificates before the interview for verification. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Field Worker post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The post is purely temporary, co-terminus with the project, and has an initial appointment of one year that can be continued for the next year based on performance.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the monthly emoluments?
faq.answer: Yes, the position carries emoluments of Rs. 24,000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is provided according to Government of India norms for the maximum age limit of 50 years.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: The Principal Investigator restricts the number of candidates called for the interview to a reasonable limit based on qualifications and experience, and shortlisted candidates are intimated by email.

faq.question: Q5. What subject line should be used when emailing the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must write “Application for Field-Worker-Oct-2026” in the subject line of the email.
